records_captured: Stat Point spreads from the same files: per Pokémon, its MAX_SPREADS (10) most-run nature and Stat Point spreads. Ladder only; tournament team sheets publish no spreads

fields.name: month
fields.description: The month the statistics cover, YYYY-MM

fields.name: metagame
fields.description: Smogon's metagame slug, the regulation registry's munchstats_format ("gen9championsvgc2026regmc")

fields.name: regulation_code
fields.description: The registered regulation the file belongs to (dbt/seeds/champions_regulations.csv)

fields.name: variant
fields.description: bo1 or bo3: the Showdown ladder the battles were played on

fields.name: cutoff
fields.description: Rating floor: 1760 weights each battle by the chance its players are rated above 1760; 0 counts every battle equally

fields.name: pokemon_name
fields.description: Showdown display name ("Charizard-Mega-Y"); mapped to pokemon_key by int_smogon_ladder_mapped

fields.name: weight
fields.description: Weighted count of teams that ran the spread

fields.name: share
fields.description: The spread's share of all this Pokémon's spreads in the file, 0 to 1

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: The chaos JSON file the row comes from

fields.name: source_record_id
fields.description: Unique row id within the source: month/file:Pokémon[:opponent or spread]

known_risks: Spreads are what ladder players ran. Official team sheets publish none, so they never enter tournament entities or the Builder's sets (docs/upgrade-plan-2027q2.md, D3)
